sources.observation: The upper arcade sits on a continuous stone impost. Granite pier courses, wedge-shaped arch stones and the narrow top channel remain visible.
The elevated segment changes direction at Díaz Sanz. Two arcade tiers cross Azoguejo and the upstream continuation follows a single tier.

limitations: Intermediate pier intervals, visible masonry courses and the near-ground terminal walls are estimated. The buried conduit and upstream hydraulic network are outside this asset.
